annotations.text: HOME — the interaction leads, not the object. Letterhead name line, "Put a record on." headline, a loud accent search field. Deck sits quiet (dimmed, arm parked) until a record lands on it. Dot-matrix stays behind the hero.
ABOUT — full-width portrait, left-aligned bio, all six fact chips in one wrapped row. Sized to fill the screen instead of a centred card floating in a void.

EXPERIENCE (reworked) — a photo card at a natural landscape crop (not blown up, no stretch), year + "Now" tag on a bottom scrim. Role + description sit low on the screen, just above a dot row + swipe hint. Hard snap, next card peeks. No filmstrip, no centre-focus scale, no void.

MY TASTE — the poster look is kept: torn cards, tape, tilt, Anton names, per-card pressing hues. One artist swipe row (was two rows + two dot sets), the top 5 is a numbered list inside the crate card. Fits one screen.

PROJECTS — kept as-is in spirit: liner-note tracklist, mono index numeral in its pressing hue, role kicker above title, 2-line collapsed preview, chevron. Rows just breathe out to fill exactly one screen.

CONNECT — trimmed. Cassette chrome down to a spine stripe + two reel dots. 44px name / optional-email fields, ~92px message, full-width Send. Footer (name + larger socials) sits at the bottom of the screen. Walkman send-reveal is untouched.
